description: This Java class handles the undo approval command for a specific savings application (GSIM) within the Fineract platform. It implements a command handler interface, processes a command, and delegates the undo approval action to a service.

classes.name: GSIMUndoApprovalCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the undo approval command for GSIM accounts, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and orchestrating the undo action via the associated service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the undo approval command by calling the undoGSIMApplicationApproval method of the writePlatformService with the command's entityId and the command itself.
